name: io.github.Vortitron/home-assistant-mcp
description: Home Assistant and ESPHome for coding agents: states, services, automations, dashboards, flashing.

environmentVariables.name: HA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Home Assistant's address, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123 (or use VOMEHOME_TOKEN instead)

environmentVariables.name: HA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A Home Assistant long-lived access token

environmentVariables.name: HA_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow service calls and edits; reads only without it

environmentVariables.name: VOMEHOME_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A key from the Vome app's Agent tab, to reach the home through Vome instead of HA_URL and HA_TOKEN
